dataset: CardAdvisor — India Credit Card Points Transfer Graph
description: Every Indian credit-card reward currency and every published transfer route between currencies and airline/hotel programmes, with numeric ratios, tier gates, caps and official sources. What each destination currency is worth in rupees is our valuation model and is published on cardadvisor.in/transfers, not in this dataset — the graph publishes the raw edges so any route can be evaluated against a valuation of your choosing. Independent, no paid placements. Free to cite with attribution.
citation: CardAdvisor — India Credit Card Points Transfer Graph Dataset, live snapshot as of 2026-10-01. For a citable, immutable version see https://cardadvisor.in/data/versions.

nodeFieldDictionary.id: Stable identifier for the reward currency or loyalty programme.
nodeFieldDictionary.kind: BANK (an issuer reward currency) | AIRLINE | HOTEL.
nodeFieldDictionary.name: Display name of the currency / programme.
nodeFieldDictionary.programUrl: The programme's own page, where recorded.
nodeFieldDictionary.cardCount: Active catalogue cards earning this currency (0 for partner programmes).
nodeFieldDictionary.lastVerified: When this programme’s valuation was last checked (ISO-8601). Nodes are verified on different days, so this is per-node and the dataset-level asOf is not a substitute. BANK currencies carry null: their value is derived from their own routes, so the partner node at the end of the route is what gets re-checked.

edgeFieldDictionary.fromUnits: Transfer ratio, source side — fromUnits source points convert to toUnits destination points.
edgeFieldDictionary.issuerControlled: true = the transfer is made in the bank's own portal; false = the hop happens inside your loyalty account, outside the bank's control.
edgeFieldDictionary.minTier: Minimum card tier the issuer requires for this route, where gated.
edgeFieldDictionary.confidence: HIGH | MEDIUM | LOW | UNVERIFIED — how well the ratio is documented. UNVERIFIED means no one has assessed the route yet, which is different from doubting it; before schema v4 those rows published as HIGH.
edgeFieldDictionary.sourceUrl: Official programme / issuer source for the route, where recorded.
edgeFieldDictionary.lastVerified: When this individual route was last checked (ISO-8601). Rows are verified on different days, so this is per-edge and the dataset-level asOf is not a substitute.
edgeFieldDictionary.provenanceTier: ISSUER | PROGRAMME | CARDHOLDER | UNVERIFIED — who published the document this route rests on. ISSUER is the bank that executes the transfer, in its own document, and is the party whose terms govern the ratio you receive; PROGRAMME is the destination programme describing the same route from its side. Prefer this to counting sourceUrl: the 131 citations in this dataset resolve to 30 documents, one of which stands behind 48 routes. It is not a claim that anyone read the document and confirmed the ratio — that is confidence, and 2 ISSUER-tiered routes are still UNVERIFIED on it.
edgeFieldDictionary.speed: WITHIN_A_DAY | WITHIN_THREE_DAYS | WITHIN_A_WEEK | OVER_A_WEEK | UNKNOWN — transferTime bucketed so routes are comparable. Worst case, in calendar days, with working days counted at 7/5, so 'up to 3 business days' is WITHIN_A_WEEK rather than WITHIN_THREE_DAYS. transferTime beside it stays the issuer's own wording.
